# Durin Genshin Guide

Durin Genshin Guide is an independent, single-page reference for the character Durin in Genshin Impact (5-star Pyro sword user, released Version 6.2, December 3 2025). The page covers his identity, two battle forms (White Flame support and Dark Decay Vaporize/Melt carry), best build, constellations, lore across three forms (dragon → Mini Durin → playable human), ascension materials, and pull value.

## Key facts

- Durin is a 5-star Pyro sword character from Mondstadt, constellation Draco Rubedo, title "The Undying Fire", birthday March 14.
- He has two battle stances toggled by his Elemental Skill: Confirmation of Purity (White Flame) shreds Pyro and reaction-element RES; Denial of Darkness (Dark Decay) raises his own Vaporize and Melt DMG by 40%.
- His best-in-slot weapon is Athame Artis; top artifacts are A Day Carved From Rising Winds (4pc); talent priority is Burst > Skill > Normal Attack.
- He needs very little Energy Recharge: 0% with a crowned Skill and two casts per rotation, up to 120–150% solo Pyro.
- C1 is his best-value constellation; C2 and C6 are the largest damage jumps.
- Lore: the original Durin was a shadow dragon created by Rhinedottir in Khaenri'ah, slain at Dragonspine 500 years ago; Mini Durin was written into Simulanka by Andersdotter; Albedo later gave him a human body.
- Ascension needs: Agnidus Agate gems, 168 Frostlamp Flowers, Fatui Warrant drops, 46 Cyclic Military Kuuvahki Cores; talent books are Ballad from Forsaken Rift.
- Durin's English voice actor is Laurie Kynaston; his first rerun ran in Version 6.6 from May 20 2026.

## Content sections

- Hero dossier: element, weapon, rarity, constellation, region, affiliation, release, rerun, birthday, voice actors, max stats.
- Should You Pull? — interactive verdict tool and Primogem budget calculator.
- Build — weapons, artifacts, stats, energy recharge, teams (premium and F2P), Hexerei synergy, skills, constellations with damage uplift, passives.
- Compare — Durin vs Xiangling vs Bennett, plus team damage uplift data.
- Pros, cons and rotations for both forms.
- Lore — full timeline of the three Durins and key relationships.
- Materials — ascension and talent totals, farming routes and common mistakes.
- FAQ — 35 questions and answers.
- Trust — editorial team, sources and update notes.
